name: Aeronautics & Astro (Min)

rules.name: AA Core (12 Units)
rules.notes:
NOTES

• ENGR 21 is waived as a minor requirement if already taken as part of the major program.

rules.name: Combined GPA of 2.5 in the minor's courses
Technical Electives (12 Units minimum) Choose 4 courses
rules.notes: Students may petition to use another Aero/Astro course, or engineering course in a related field as an elective; as long as it is not also being used for another program.

gpa: The minimum combined Grade Point Average for all courses in the minor is 2.5.
grading: All courses taken for the minor must be taken for a letter grade if the instructor offers that option. The minimum grade in each course is a C.
transferPolicy: Transfer credit cannot be used toward the minor.
reviewNotes: Technical electives ask for four courses and 12 units, as the rule's name says. Every course must be taken for a letter grade when the instructor offers one, with a C or better. You check the 2.5 GPA by hand. If ENGR 21 is waived because your major already used it, or a petitioned elective is approved, mark that rule done.
